lines.say: My brother is one of the smartest people I know.
At school, every report said the same thing. Capable, but lazy.
He wasn't lazy. Every day had too many starts, and nothing held the plan for him.
So I built something that does. You open it, and it tells you the next thing. Just one.
What's the hardest part of your day? Starting, switching, or remembering what's next?
